name: Lotus Eaters: Violet
source:
Step into the shoes of the university student Violet, who witnesses the horrifying sight of an otherworldly specter devouring her professor, leaving nothing behind. Not a single person around her remembers the professor, and even worse--Violet is being hunted! But by what, or whom? And for what reason?

Join Violet as she attempts to uncover the truth behind this mysterious disappearance,  all the while trying to avoid her pursuers  as the world twists and turns around her.  What is real? What is fiction?   It is up to you to ensure she does not succumb to a terrible fate ... Will you uncover what lies beyond the Veil?

[From [url=https://lotus-eaters-studio.itch.io/lotus-eaters-violet-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演大学生Violet，亲眼目睹一个异界幽灵吞噬了她的教授，现场没有留下任何东西。周围没有任何人记得这名教授。更糟的是，Violet正遭到追杀！究竟是什么，或者是谁在追捕她？又是为了什么？

加入Violet，一边躲避追捕者，一边揭开这起神秘失踪事件的真相。与此同时，周围的世界也在不断扭曲。什么是真实？什么又是虚构？由你决定如何确保她不会屈服于可怕的命运……你能否揭开帷幕后隐藏的东西？
